Consider the vector field $F=⟨z,\,0,\,2⟩$ and the closed surface $S$ that represents the boundary of the solid shown above. Let $D$ be the projection of $S$ onto the $xy$-plane. The flux of $F$ across $S$ can be expressed in terms of a double integral as 

$$
{∬}_{S}F\cdot dS={∬}_{D}\,\,\text{d}A.
$$

Which of the following could be the missing expression?

Consider the vector field F=⟨z,0,2⟩ and the closed surface S that represents the boundary of the solid shown above. Let D be the projection of S onto the xy-plane. The flux of F across S can be expressed in terms of a double integral as ∬SF⋅dS=∬DAAAAAAAdA. Which of the following could be the missing expression?

a
yx2+y2−2
b
xx2+y2+y
c
xyx2+y2+2
d
yx2+y2−y
e
xx2+y2−x
